extracted text: The 6061-T6 aluminum alloy and the S25C steel were studied to determine differences in fatigue crack closure behavior. The 6061-T6 exhibited plasticity-induced fatigue crack closure (PIFCC), while the S25C steel exhibited roughness-induced crack closure (RIFCC). The S25C steel was in the normalized condition and had an α-grain size of 14 μm.
